Is rolling back an odometer illegal?.answer: Yes. Under 49 U.S.C. 32703 it is illegal to disconnect, reset or alter an odometer with intent to change the recorded mileage, or to sell or install a device that does. NHTSA enforces it and has said an odometer-stopping device has no legitimate use.

What do the last six characters of a VIN.answer: Positions 12 to 17 of a VIN are the manufacturer's production sequence number (49 CFR 565.6(d)(3)), assigned in build order for makers of 500 or more vehicles of a type a year. The count runs per model and can wrap from 999999 back to 000001, so two different vehicles can share the same last six.

How deep must a dead goat be buried in O.answer: ORS 601.090 requires a buried carcass to be covered by at least four feet of earth. ODA guidance adds distances: at least 100 feet, and ideally 500, from wells and surface water, a dry hole, no floodplains. Near a dwelling, disposal is due within 15 hours (ORS 601.140).
